caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object featuring a lion, a tree trunk, and two monkeys. The lion is positioned on the right side, colored in shades of yellow and brown with a lighter underbelly, its head raised, mouth open, and its front right paw placed on the tree trunk. The tree trunk, positioned to the left of the lion, is mostly brown with some green and yellow hues at its base, suggesting moss or grass. There are two monkeys on the tree: the lower monkey, hanging onto the trunk, is dark brown, while the upper monkey, also brown, holds what looks like a small object in its hand, reaching out playfully toward the lion. The base of the composition is a wide, curved platform that is mottled with greens, yellows, and browns, and features a floral-like embossed detail on its left side. The background is a plain off-white color, with a large black rectangle in the upper right corner of the image.
title: Toy Bank
